result:
The game now reloads into the title when the same error repeats every frame for 5 seconds. It shipped as v32.96, and the gate and the seed 4242 fingerprint passed.

- **Trigger:** the same error from the same place has to repeat within a second of itself for 5 seconds or more, at least 10 times a second on average. Digits in the message are ignored when matching.
- **What happens:**
  - The crash is already in the run report from its first hit.
  - After the trigger, no further saves happen, so the last good save stays.
  - The page reloads once, and the title shows "restarted after an error" for about 4 seconds, then fades.
- **Never triggers on:** one error, a burst under 5 seconds, a hidden page, the fixture or gate pages, or a second time after the first restart.
- **Checks:** they use a fake clock and a stubbed reload.
  - A 6.5-second fault gives exactly one reload and sets the title note.
  - A 3-second burst and a single fault give none.
  - A fault on a hidden page gives none.
  - I did not run the control against v32.90 separately, because the new functions don't exist there and the check fails at once.
- **2-player:** I did not see it in two windows. The reloading window drops its link the way a closed window does, but I haven't confirmed the other window carries on. It needs the party rig.
- **For the next playtest:**
  - A real run should restart to the title only when an error repeats every frame for 5 seconds.
  - The title note should appear and then fade.
  - The note is a plain text line with no picture taken.
  - If a window reloads during the 2-player demo, watch the other one.
